response.sql: WITH dc AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, c.district_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client c JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3, c.district_id) SELECT region, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client)) AS avg_share_of_all_clients FROM dc GROUP BY region
